responses.feedback: The assistant offers help in  a polite and relaxed manner even though the user seems rude. The user is therefore satisfied at the end of the call even though they seem too demanding.
The assistant ended the call appropriately and even asked the user if they had any other issue to be assisted with. The user retorted by saying no.
The assistant was very straight forward and did not repeat responses. This is despite the fact that the user was rather rude.

They break down the presented issue and even strive to offer a summary of the solution. The user does not care. Nevertheless, the assistant offers meaningful insights that ensure the issue is resolved.
The assistant was consistently polite throughout the interaction. In this regard, they strived to be helpful to the rude user

-The assistant guides the user on how to resolve the issue 
-The assistant offers to answer any more question or issue the user has
-The assistant remains professional and friendly
